name: linkversity
description: Discover Linkversity collections, access your saved learning resources, and save new links from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Search public Linkversity collections by topic, open the links inside a collection, connect your own Linkversity account to retrieve your saved collections, and save new links or create new collections straight from the chat - just name the collection and it is created automatically if it does not exist yet. Every result links back to the original resource on Linkversity. Linkversity is a link manager: collections of saved links grouped into sections.
defaultPrompt: Find public Linkversity collections about machine learning
